description: Scored company briefs from SEC EDGAR for 14 large US companies (Apple, Microsoft, Nvidia, Amazon, Walmart, JPMorgan, Bank of America, Exxon, Pfizer, Lilly, J&J, UnitedHealth, Netflix, Disney): fundamentals, filing risk (8-K items, 13D, Form 4), insider activity, balance sheet strength, a peer ranking, earnings quality, shareholder returns (buybacks and dividends), interest coverage, the investment cycle (capex), settlement fails (SEC fails-to-deliver) and institutional ownership (13F). Every input carries its SEC citation. POST /v1/brief {vertical, entity_id} returns one scored brief; POST /v1/overview returns every brief at once; POST /v1/verticals lists them. Verticals: fundamentals (How healthy are this company's financials versus its own recent history?); filing-risk (Has this company filed anything risky lately?); insider-activity (Are this company's insiders trading more than usual?); balance-sheet (How strong is this company's liquidity and leverage versus its own history?); peer-ranking (How does this company rank against the other 13 large US companies on growth, profitability and cash generation?); public-attention (Is public attention on this company spiking?); earnings-quality (Are this company's profits backed by cash?); shareholder-returns (Is this company returning more cash to shareholders than usual?); interest-coverage (Can this company comfortably cover its interest bill?); investment-cycle (Is this company investing more in plant and equipment than usual?); settlement-fails (Are trades in this stock failing to settle more than usual?); institutional-ownership (Are more institutions holding this stock than a year ago?). Raw scored series: /v1/signals, /v1/signal, /v1/explain, /v1/catalog, /v1/events. Every response is a single JSON object. Research signal, not investment advice.

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/verticals, POST /v1/brief, POST /v1/overview, POST /v1/signals, POST /v1/signal, POST /v1/explain, POST /v1/catalog, POST /v1/events; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only. Bad input returns 400 + JSON.

serving.backend: Node.js HTTP server (zero npm dependencies) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. No caller auth. Answers come from a private hub refreshed by a scheduled collector of official public data; 5-minute cache.
serving.notes: Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
